description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Qualtrics is hiring a Software Engineer I for its XM Directory Engineering team. The role builds backend services and web interfaces, implements and tests features, fixes bugs, and collaborates with engineers, product, and design to deliver customer value.
Software Engineer I implementing features and fixing bugs across backend services and web interfaces with guidance and tested code

Responsibilities:
• Build backend services and web interfaces while learning our stack
• Implement features and fix bugs with guidance from teammates, using AI-assisted tools to work faster and learn more
• Work with senior engineers to break down requirements, and make sure what you build works
• Write well-tested code, review your own and AI-assisted work carefully, and give and receive feedback in code reviews
• Learn our codebase and tools, and ask questions early
• Collaborate with teammates, product, and design in the team’s agile practices to deliver value to customers

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
• Prior software engineering experience through internships, co-ops, academic coursework, or personal/open-source projects
• Solid algorithms, data structures, and coding fundamentals
• Exposure to web infrastructure and distributed systems
• Familiarity or experience with modern developer tools, git, unit testing, and continuous deployment concepts
• Foundational understanding of clean coding principles, with a strong eagerness to learn, take guidance, and contribute to team goals
